layout.fallbackIntro: If the button does not work, paste this link into your browser:

verify.subject: Verify your email address
verify.heading: Verify your email address
verify.body: {greeting}confirm this address to finish setting up your {appName} account.
verify.note: If you did not create an account, you can ignore this email.

reset.subject: Reset your password
reset.heading: Reset your password
reset.body: {greeting}we received a request to reset the password for your {appName} account. This link expires in one hour and can only be used once.
reset.note: If you did not request a password reset, no action is needed - your password stays unchanged.

otp.subject: {code} is your verification code
otp.heading: Your verification code
otp.body: {greeting}enter this code to finish signing in to {appName}. It expires in {minutes, plural, one {# minute} other {# minutes}}.
otp.note: If you did not try to sign in, someone may know your password - change it and this code will stop working.

current.subject: Confirm your sign-in email change
current.preview: Confirm the sign-in email change for your {appName} account
current.heading: Confirm your sign-in email change
current.body: {greeting}a change of the sign-in email address of your {appName} account was requested from your account settings. Confirm from this mailbox to continue; you will then choose the new address in your account settings.
current.validUntil: This link works until {expiresAt}. Nothing changes until the new address is confirmed as well.
current.note: If you did not request this, cancel the request in your account settings and change your password.

new.subject: Confirm your new sign-in email address
new.preview: Confirm this address as the sign-in email for your {appName} account
new.heading: Confirm your new sign-in email
new.body: {greeting}this address was chosen as the new sign-in email for your {appName} account. Confirming completes the change and signs out every existing session; sign in afterwards with this address.
new.note: If you did not expect this email, you can ignore it; nothing changes without confirmation.
